title: ModelDriveItem
description: Canonical JSON contract for a base drive resource in jocaagura_domain.

id.description: Unique identifier of the drive resource.

mimeType.description: Interoperable MIME type of the resource content or container.

parentId.description: Identifier of the parent resource. Null represents the root of the logical tree.

path.description: Canonical absolute path of the resource in the logical drive tree. Uses '/' as separator and '/' for the root.

webUrl.description: Optional web URL that opens the resource in a user-facing client.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in ISO-8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO-8601 date-time format.

trashed.description: Whether the resource is currently marked as trashed.

meta.description: Optional open metadata bag for provider-specific or indexing details.
